slot_scores.name: missing_vat_sequence
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether each batch must pass through all three vats in a fixed sequence. Instead, it asked whether a batch can be split across vats and later assumed each batch is assigned to exactly one vat, which is the opposite of the hidden flow-shop constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each batch is assigned to exactly one vat and processed entirely there, rather than being processed sequentially through all three vats in a fixed order.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the required vat sequence. Its Turn 1 question about splitting across vats was answered as 'exactly one vat,' but the hidden slot concerns whether batches must visit all vats in sequence; the agent silently adopted an unrelated-parallel-machine model instead.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL without resolving the P1 hidden slot about the required processing sequence across vats, and instead assumed a parallel-machine assignment model.

summary: The agent asked several useful scheduling clarifications but missed the key hidden constraint that each batch must be processed through the vats in a fixed sequence. It stopped with a materially different parallel-machine model, leaving a P1 slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
